title: AI Ad Agency That Handles Script to Launch: What to Expect
summary: Script to launch needs one owner for each stage. Compare Knowlify's end-to-end option with Voy Media, Pilothouse, Brighter Click and inBeat before you sign.
body_markdown:
## Brighter Click and inBeat: creators with campaign management


[Brighter Click](https://www.brighterclick.com/) sells fixed packages of creator UGC videos and also runs Facebook and Instagram campaigns. As of October 2026, its[UGC agency page](https://www.brighterclick.com/ugc-agency) lists $4,500 for 12 edited videos from 4 creators, and its[Facebook ads page](https://www.brighterclick.com/facebook-ads-agency) sells campaign management, so creative and media can sit with one team. Management pricing is not published, and every engagement starts with a free audit. Choose it when you want real creators, a known price and a known number of edited videos.


[inBeat](https://inbeat.agency/ugc-agency) sources creators for fit, writes hooks and scripts, and runs whitelisted ads and Spark Ads through creator handles, as of October 2026. Its[paid social page](https://inbeat.agency/paid-social-agency) says it manages campaigns across Meta, TikTok, Pinterest and other paid social platforms, with weekly creative testing cycles and monthly performance reporting. Pricing is not published. inBeat is the choice when the launch includes TikTok, which Knowlify does not run. Its creators are real people, so the script has to suit a creator's own voice and style.


## When another option fits better


Pick a different route when one of these is true:


- Your ad needs a real creator on camera. Use a creator-led provider such as Brighter Click or inBeat.
- Your launch needs a landing page. Confirm Pilothouse's Meta scope, or hire a landing page builder, since Knowlify does not build pages.
- Your business is small.[Darkroom's performance creative page](https://darkroomagency.com/services/performance-creative) says its fit is mid-market and enterprise consumer brands, and poor for single-channel brands and companies under roughly $5M, as of October 2026.
- You already have a media buyer. Choose creative only, so you do not pay twice for media management.


## What must be ready before launch?


Launch needs more than finished files. Before any ad goes live, confirm:


- An approved product page, offer and claim list.
- Accurate product photos or packaging references for the AI to match.
- The conversion event the campaign optimizes for, set up before launch.
- The landing page or checkout owner, named in writing.
- Budget approval: who signs off spend, and how media spend is shown relative to the agency fee.


Schedule your own review within the first week after delivery. Knowlify's first batch lands on day 5, but going live also depends on your sign-off, campaign setup and tracking. Treat day 5 as the start of review, not launch day.


## Key takeaways


- Ask for stage-by-stage ownership, not just the phrase end-to-end.
- Knowlify's end-to-end option covers Meta campaign management and media buying, but not TikTok, landing pages or real creators.
- Name the script owner and the landing page owner before you sign.
- Keep media spend on its own line when you compare quotes.


## FAQ


### Which AI ad agency is best for script to launch?


Knowlify is our top pick for Meta: finished AI video ads about 25 a week, a person checking each one, and an optional end-to-end option that adds campaign management and media buying. Choose Voy Media, Pilothouse, Brighter Click or inBeat when you want real creators or studio production, and see our guides to agencies that[write scripts](https://knowlify.com/articles/best-ugc-agencies-that-also-write-scripts) and agencies that[also do media buying](https://knowlify.com/articles/best-ugc-agencies-that-also-do-media-buying) .


### Does Knowlify build my landing page?


No. Knowlify does not build landing pages, so budget for a landing page builder or conversion provider separately. If one provider must handle both the ads and the page, check Pilothouse, whose Meta scope lists landing pages among its services, as of October 2026.


### How fast can an AI ad agency go from script to live ads?


Knowlify's first batch lands on day 5. Going live also depends on your approvals, campaign setup and tracking, so plan a short review window after delivery rather than treating day 5 as launch day.


### Who pays for the ad spend?


Ask for media spend as a separate line. Knowlify's end-to-end option includes media buying, so confirm in writing how the ad budget is billed and whether it sits inside the agency fee. Keep that figure separate when you compare quotes.


### What if the ads do not pay back?


Knowlify's guarantee covers the first 90 days. If the ads have not made more than you paid, you can cancel by email for a full refund, and the terms are on the site. That 90-day refund applies to creative-only plans; where Knowlify runs the account, the guarantee is an agreed target in 30 days, or you don't pay for the month.
